title: The Market Bell
subtitle: The market does not close. It stops
description: At four, or whenever the lanterns agree, the bell is rung once and
the alley is a wall again. The press is the acknowledgement; the
Its reward is written inline rather than in a table file -- a
`tasked:loot` with its own `entries` and an `emptyWeight`, the
same dice the vagrant king rolls, carried in the quest instead of
the folder. Both forms are the same table; the inline one is for
rolls that belong to exactly one quest.
